operations.observable_completion: Trusted object/interface/readback or immutable receipt establishes completion; narration and requested command do not.

operation_semantics: Reusable operation templates instantiated by route, object ID, condition and attempt. Counts are authored granularity, not historical step counts. Conditional postconditions require trusted receipts; failed disposition never emits acceptance.
